# İsmail Çelik

> Senior Software & AI Engineer in Ankara, Türkiye (GMT+3), remote-ready. 10+ years building backend services, mobile apps and the infrastructure they run on; now shipping LLM features to production: agents, RAG and on-device ML.

## Profile

- Current: Senior Software Engineer at Netelsan (Dec 2025 – present). Backend and platform engineering for IP intercom, burglar alarm and smart-home products: WebRTC service infrastructure on AWS, Prometheus/Grafana observability, automated release pipeline to the production line.
- Previous: Software Engineer (contract) for Al Samah Est., sole engineer on a company-wide ERP (Java, Spring Boot, React, Flutter), 2022–2023; Software Engineer at Netelsan, 2021–2022; Mobile Application Developer at Bitcraft, 2019–2021; IT Specialist at Alfa E-Ticaret, 2018–2019; System & Network Engineer, Turkish Naval Forces, 2013–2016.
- Education: BSc Computer Engineering, Karadeniz Technical University (2013); BSc Business Administration, Anadolu University (2025); BSc Management Information Systems, Istanbul University (ongoing).
- Contact: ismailceliktr00@gmail.com · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ismailcelik) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr)

## Selected work

- [Netelsan Cloud](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/netelsan-cloud/id6757862775?l=en): Mobile cloud app for Netelsan users on iOS and Android. React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
- [Netelsan Burglar Alarm System](https://apps.apple.com/py/app/netelsan-h%C4%B1rs%C4%B1z-alarm-sistemi/id1384915254): Production mobile app for monitoring and managing burglar alarms. React Native, Node.js, MongoDB.
- [VectraX](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/vectrax): Real-time, operator-driven visual tracking that follows any boxed object frame by frame and reports its confidence. Python, OpenCV, Core ML, RF-DETR.
- [SMD Vision Inspector](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/smd-vision-inspector): Deterministic computer-vision inspection for SMD placement lines. Python, OpenCV.
- [The Message (Çağrı)](https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/the-message-daily-guide/id6773722876): Turkish/English Islamic guidance app with scheduled daily notifications. React Native, Expo, NestJS, Supabase. [Source](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/the-message)
- [Tilavet Meal](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/tilavet-meal): Listens to live Quran recitation and plays the verified Turkish meal of the recited ayah; 0 wrong meals across 837 blind tests, runs on-device on iPhone. Python, Swift, speech recognition.
- [DilKart](https://dilkart.fly.dev): Offline-first English flashcards with FSRS spaced repetition and a three-way dictionary, synced across iOS and web. TypeScript, Expo, SQLite, Supabase. [Source](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/dilkart)
- [Claude Code Guide](https://github.com/ismailcelik-tr/claude-code-guide): Practical guide to using Claude Code at every stage of development, in English and Turkish.
